note: The plan wants the recording in real time, the client's images as given and captions only on most rows. Use the full-frame cards only if the client asks for more.

mg.title: The website

text.main: First, you need to make sure that you are on voterlookup.elections.ny.gov.

mg.use: Full-frame as she says it, in place of the still frame with the top band text. Use one, not both.

mg.title: Brackets on the QR code
mg.use: Frames the QR code as she says “QR code”. Never over the code itself.

mg.title: Select your county
mg.src: Rebecca, Main St.m4a [00:20.4] “you're going to select your county”
mg.use: In the top purple band as she says it. Keep it off the form.

mg.title: The four fields
mg.use: In the top band. Each field name lands on her word. Never over the blurred values.

mg.title: Click search
mg.use: In the top band. Time it so “search” lands on the click.

mg.title: Registration information

text.main: And this will give you all of your registration information.

mg.use: Full-frame only while the blurred result page loads, as she says it. Be off before the push to Active.

mg.title: Status is active
mg.use: In the top band. Land it on “active”, when the push arrives on the line.

mg.title: It's all there
mg.use: In the top band only, as she says it. The held Active line stays clear and sharp.
